traversalsNote: Game uu. Ropes, ziplines, teleporters and jumps measured on the scene: a and b are the walk-grid cells at the two ends (they become roadmap nodes joined by a link in <map>.nav.json), zones the zone at each end. See tools/map-mesh/README.md.

traversals.name: A site rope
traversals.basis: Game metres. Cable Ascender_0_CableA (x,y 87.41, 49.38; z -1.89..6.68) under the housing Kingdom_0_VertAscenderA (z 6.43..6.71). a = the 3.00 m floor cell at the cable, b = the 6.64 m floor cell at its top (same x,y, 3.64 m higher). Both are on the main floor: the rope is a short cut.
traversals.provenance: measured-on-mesh (object position, the two walk cells, length 3.64 m); manual-approx (travel time = length / 6.75 m/s — speed assumed equal to the movement model's run speed (6.75 m/s): the game's rope / zipline speed was not measured; that the object is a usable rope: object name and game knowledge)
